verdict.rationale: Workable documents a webhook subscription endpoint where integrators register their own service to receive event notifications, with an args object for filtering which candidate events are delivered. That meets the requirement for registrable outbound HTTP callbacks a programmatic consumer can receive. Missing for 10: a documented list of event types, payload schema, signature/verification and retry semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: You can use this endpoint to register your service. The args object can be used to further filter which candidate events you want to receive.
You can subscribe to an event and Workable will notify you when it's triggered.
